route.reason: warrior-queen assets benefit from stronger human presence and composed maturity
route.rule: route by character and output intent; user-explicit face mode always overrides automatic routing.

face_mode.label: Humanized Real Face
face_mode.goal: increase photographic human presence while preserving identity and attractiveness
prompt_translation: Increase realistic human presence in the face while preserving the approved identity and attractiveness.
Use believable eyelid anatomy, soft tissue, regional skin response and natural nose/lip structure instead of plastic CG smoothness.
Keep the face young and attractive; realism must not become fatigue, hollowness or age inflation.
face_mode.principle: face direction is style-dependent; beauty, age impression and identity can take priority over maximum facial photorealism.

prompt_translation: Keep a refined young-adult impression without aging the character up.
Allow restrained maturity through gaze and presentation, not through fatigue or facial hollowing.
maturity_guard.principle: maturity guard limits unwanted age drift; it does not force childishness.

realism_scope.rule: never infer that high non-face realism requires high face realism.

round_plan.prompt_strategy: face-mode-only calibration: protect identity and age impression, tune beauty/realism direction without changing body, costume or composition

prompt_skeleton: Increase realistic human presence in the face while preserving the approved identity and attractiveness.

Keep the face young and attractive; realism must not become fatigue, hollowness or age inflation.
Keep a refined young-adult impression without aging the character up.
Allow restrained maturity through gaze and presentation, not through fatigue or facial hollowing.
Face realism scope: medium_high; non-face realism scope: high.
